BeHeard Zimbabwe is a registered Private Voluntary Organisation based in Victoria Falls, Zimbabwe, dedicated to improving the lives of vulnerable individuals, children, women and families.

Meet Our Founder

Her vision for BeHeard Zimbabwe is to create a platform where individuals who are often overlooked can be heard, supported and empowered to build better futures.
